captions.detailed: A fixie track bicycle crankset assembly consisting of a central bottom bracket shell, a spindle, a single-ring cogwheel chainring, two silver-colored crank arms, and two black pedals with orange reflectors. The central spindle, both crank arms, and the chainring rotate together as a single continuous unit. Each pedal is mounted on its axle at the end of its respective crank arm and rotates continuously independently.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a track bike crankset using CadQuery. The assembly should feature a central bottom bracket, a rotating spindle, light-grey crank arms, a large keyed track chainring on the drive side, and two black pedals with small orange reflectors. Ensure the spindle rotates continuously and both pedals can spin on their respective axles.
captions.factory: Construct a bottom bracket shell using a cylinder primitive. Create the spindle as a concentric cylinder. Model the crank arms by lofting or extruding a rounded profile with mounting holes at both ends. Generate the chainring by patterning teeth around a thin disk with a 5-spoke spider hub. Build the pedals from rectangular blocks and cylindrical shafts, adding a small orange box for the reflector. Define continuous joints for the spindle rotation and independent continuous joints for each pedal relative to its crank arm.
